title: Shangri-La (novel) — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
Shangri-La (novel) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Shangri-La (Japanese: シャングリ·ラ, Hepburn: Shanguri Ra) is a Japanese science fiction light novel, written by Eiichi Ikegami and illustrated by Ken'ichi Yoshida. The novel was initially serialized in Kadokawa Shoten's  Newtype magazine between April 2004 and May 2005.

Nobody designed the part of Shangri-La (novel) you experience — it was inherited. Using these "debts," MEDUSA generates vast amounts of money for Ishida Finance through various manipulations of the carbon market (similar to the stock market). MEDUSA is originally believed to be the only program in the world that can perform these manipulations of carbon credits, but it seems that there are other programs similar to it operating across the globe.
